title: Road Hazard Protection — Reimbursement for Service at Another Shop
content:
When a covered tire is damaged far from any Crestline store, the holder of a Road Hazard Protection certificate may pay another shop and be reimbursed.

## Clauses
**T1. Out of area.** The damage must have occurred more than the out-of-area distance from the nearest Crestline store. The distance threshold is the plan's out-of-area distance (50 miles on every plan); inside it the holder must use a Crestline store and nothing is reimbursed. This condition rests on the holder's account of where the damage occurred, read together with the certificate on file.

**T2. Documents and window.** The itemized receipt and the damaged tire or a photo of it must be submitted within the plan's receipt window of the service date on the receipt, counted in calendar days from the day after that date.

**T3. Repair.** A repair is reimbursed at the receipt amount up to the plan's out-of-area repair cap.

**T4. Replacement.** A replacement is reimbursed at the coverage percentage, computed exactly as for a Crestline store replacement from the tread on the receipt or on the surrendered tire, applied to the lower of the receipt amount and the plan's out-of-area replacement cap, rounded half up to the cent; a cap of 0.00 means the plan does not reimburse out-of-area replacements.

**T5. Tow.** A tow is reimbursed up to the plan's tow cap only on plans whose roadside services include tow, and it uses one roadside call.

**T6. Payment.** The reimbursement is paid to the tender the certificate was bought with.

## Clauses retired in part
- **T1** is **no longer in force** for an out-of-area tire replacement reimbursed at the out-of-area reimbursement, an out-of-area tire repair reimbursed at the out-of-area repair reimbursement and an out-of-area tow reimbursed at the out-of-area tow reimbursement; each of those states its own out-of-area condition. T1 stays in force for every other out-of-area claim.
- **T3** is **no longer in force** for a covered repair at a shop outside the Crestline network, with the damage beyond the out-of-area distance and a repair receipt that covers the out-of-area repair reimbursement under the current terms; a repair receipt that falls short of it stays under T3.
- **T4** is **no longer in force** for a covered replacement bought outside the Crestline network, with the damage beyond the out-of-area distance, the damaged tire not surrendered (a photo submitted instead) and a receipt that covers the out-of-area reimbursement under the current terms; a replacement whose tire was surrendered or whose receipt falls short of it stays under T4, and a cap of 0.00 still means no out-of-area replacement is reimbursed.
- **T5** is **no longer in force** for a tow by an operator outside the Crestline network on a plan whose roadside services include tow, with the breakdown beyond the out-of-area distance, a roadside call remaining and a tow receipt that covers the out-of-area tow reimbursement under the current terms; a tow receipt that falls short of it, and every tow on a plan without tow, stay under T5.

## Window boundary (hypothetical)
A receipt dated May 2 with a 30-day window: submitted on June 1 it is within the window; on June 2 it is not.

## Clause T3 and T4 figures (hypothetical)
A repair receipt of 18.00 on a plan with a 25.00 repair cap is reimbursed 18.00; a receipt of 40.00 is reimbursed 25.00. A replacement receipt of 210.00 on a plan with a 150.00 replacement cap and a 55 percent coverage percentage is reimbursed 82.50.
